list.name: org
list.label: Organisation
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT organisation_id::text FROM core_auditlog WHERE organisation_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '90 days' ORDER BY 1

list.name: action
list.label: Action
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM core_auditlog WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' ORDER BY 1

list.name: feature
list.label: Feature (model)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_name FROM core_auditlog WHERE model_name <> '' AND created_at > now() - interval '90 days' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Total actions" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) AND action IN (${action:sqlstring}) AND model_name IN (${feature:sqlstring})

SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Active users" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) AND action IN (${action:sqlstring}) AND model_name IN (${feature:sqlstring})
SELECT count(DISTINCT organisation_id) AS "Active organisations" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) AS "Logins" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action = 'login' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) AS "Exports" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action = 'export' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) AS "Deletes" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action = 'delete' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring})

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), action AS metric, count(*) AS "actions" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) AND action IN (${action:sqlstring}) AND model_name IN (${feature:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, action ORDER BY 1
SELECT action AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) GROUP BY action ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT model_name AS feature, count(*) AS hits FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model_name <> '' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), model_name AS metric, count(*) AS "hits" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model_name <> '' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) AND model_name IN (SELECT model_name FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND model_name <> '' GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY 1, model_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT user_email AS "User", count(*) AS "Actions" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND user_email <> '' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) AND action IN (${action:sqlstring}) AND model_name IN (${feature:sqlstring}) GROUP BY user_email ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT organisation_id::text AS "Organisation", count(*) AS "Actions", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Users" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND organisation_id IS NOT NULL AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) GROUP BY organisation_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT created_at AS "Time", user_email AS "Superuser", organisation_id::text AS "Org", object_repr AS "Detail", ip_address AS "IP" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action = 'support_access' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT created_at AS "Time", user_email AS "User", model_name AS "Feature", object_repr AS "Object", organisation_id::text AS "Org", ip_address AS "IP" FROM core_auditlog WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action = 'delete' AND organisation_id::text IN (${org:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
